content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for WBUHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are released by WBUHS?
faq.answer: WBUHS has released a total of 5 vacancies for the post of Assistant Professor across various medical departments in the College of Medicine and JNM Hospital, Kalyani.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for WBUHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email for the Assistant Professor recruitment is 15 October 2026, up to 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via email. Candidates must scan their filled application and necessary documents into a single PDF and send it to the official recruitment email address.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for WBUHS Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Assistant Professor recruitment process at WBUHS.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post Graduate degree and meet the specific eligibility criteria as per the current rules and regulations set by the National Medical Commission.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for WBUHS?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor posts at WBUHS consists of an interview round for all eligible candidates who submit their applications on time.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply if I am from a different state?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from any state can apply provided they meet the educational and professional qualifications stipulated by the National Medical Commission for the respective posts.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit their bio-data, educational certificates, experience certificates, and ID proof, all forwarded by the Head of the Department and the Principal of their respective college.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be posted at the College of Medicine and JNM Hospital, WBUHS, located in Kalyani, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q10. Is the application required to be forwarded by an authority?
faq.answer: Yes, the application form must be forwarded by the concerned Head of the Department and the Principal of the College of Medicine and JNM Hospital, WBUHS, before submission.
